title: The cube at every doubling
claim: Under A99's moves and the cheapest rule (fewest states, up to three betweenness knots per step, any tie rule), from one knot the base at n = 2^d is the cube Q_d for every d >= 2 in every run: from Q_s the cheapest steps are the s 2^(s-1) subdivisions and 2^s pendants, after either every unoccupied orientation has a three-knot certificate, certificates survive fills, so the cube fills before a new split is needed (STATE-RULES S6).
standard_statement: Greedy single-point extension of a split system by betweenness constraints of arity three; hypercube cut systems.
prior_work: STATE-RULES-20261117-001 (S1, S4, S5, S6 conjectured); KNOT-CAP-20261117-001 (the forcing restatement).
completion_gate: Ticket B's frozen check verifies the certificates for s = 2 to 7, the step analysis for s = 2 to 4, and the exact distribution to n = 20; the referee reviews the proof.
